title: Surjectivity and exactness in Mod(O_X) of a ringed space are local lifting of sections (Stacks 01AF, 01AG)
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on (the open sets of) $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; it is abelian, and the kernel of $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ is the sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $W\mapsto\ker(\varphi_W)$. Then: (1) a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is surjective (an epimorphism of $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$, equivalently $\operatorname{Coker}\varphi=0$) if and only if it is surjective as a map of sheaves: for every open $W\subseteq X$ and every $h\in\mathcal H(W)$ there are an open covering $W=\bigcup_iW_i$ and sections $g_i\in\mathcal G(W_i)$ with $\varphi_{W_i}(g_i)=h|_{W_i}$; (2) a complex $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\chi}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\varphi}\mathcal H$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules ($\varphi\circ\chi=0$) is exact at $\mathcal G$ (the image of $\chi$ equals $\operatorname{Ker}\varphi$ in $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$) if and only if for every open $W\subseteq X$ and every $g\in\mathcal G(W)$ with $\varphi_W(g)=0$ there are an open covering $W=\bigcup_iW_i$ and sections $f_i\in\mathcal F(W_i)$ with $\chi_{W_i}(f_i)=g|_{W_i}$.

proof.text: Evaluation on each open preserves kernels by lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise. Map the exact kernel sequence through evaluation; ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff identifies its sectionwise range with the sections killed by the morphism. Evaluation also preserves the monomorphism kernel.ι, so its components are injective.
Apply Preadditive.epi_iff_isZero_cokernel in the abelian category of module sheaves to obtain Epi φ iff IsZero (cokernel φ).

The forgetful functor to abelian sheaves preserves finite colimits by lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful, using the already proved source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesFiniteColimits_toSheaf. It therefore preserves epis, and faithfulness implies it reflects epis. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi and TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff give the neighborhood lifting criterion for the underlying abelian sheaf morphism. Any covering lift supplies a lift on a neighborhood of every point. Conversely choose one lifting neighborhood for each point of W, indexed by the subtype W : Type u; these opens lie in W and cover W. This proves the exact covering formulation, including the empty-open case.

For χ ≫ φ = 0, let K = kernel φ, k = kernel.ι φ, and l = kernel.lift φ χ h. Then l ≫ k = χ. ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift says exactness is equivalent to Epi l. Apply the preceding covering criterion to l.

A section g killed by φ has a preimage s under k on the same open, by the first step. A local lift of s under l gives a lift of g under χ by l ≫ k = χ and naturality of k. Conversely local lifts under χ of k(s) give local lifts of s under l: apply k to the desired equality, use the factorization and naturality, then cancel the sectionwise injective k. This supplies both directions of the local exactness equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem module_exactness_local_lifting (X : RingedSpace.{u}) : (∀ (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (φ : F ⟶ G) (W : Opens X), Set.range (ConcreteCategory.hom ((kernel.ι φ).val.app (op W))) = {g | φ.val.app (op W) g = 0}) ∧ (∀ (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (φ : F ⟶ G), (Epi φ ↔ IsZero (cokernel φ)) ∧ ((∀ (W : Opens X) (t : G.val.obj (op W)), (∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Opens X) (hV : ∀ i, V i ≤ W) (g : ∀ i, F.val.obj (op (V i))), (⨆ i, V i) = W ∧ ∀ i, φ.val.app (op (V i)) (g i) = G.val.map (homOfLE (hV i)).op t)) ↔ Epi φ)) ∧ (∀ (F G H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (χ : F ⟶ G) (φ : G ⟶ H) (h : χ ≫ φ = 0), (ShortComplex.mk χ φ h).Exact ↔ ∀ (W : Opens X) (g : G.val.obj (op W)), φ.val.app (op W) g = 0 → ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Opens X) (hV : ∀ i, V i ≤ W) (f : ∀ i, F.val.obj (op (V i))), (⨆ i, V i) = W ∧ ∀ i, χ.val.app (op (V i)) (f i) = G.val.map (homOfLE (hV i)).op g)
